scoring_justification: Recomputation of the FDTD simulation is infeasible inside the verifier; structural audit of the extracted reflectance spectrum and field intensity map verifies the presence of the LSPR dip and the asymmetric enhancement pattern.

outputs.description: Reflectance spectrum over 400–900 nm; structural audit checks LSPR dip position (within 600–650 nm) and depth (drop ≥0.3).
2D |E|² map at 550 nm; structural audit checks asymmetric enhancement (max intensity in top/bottom regions ≥60× minimum in central region, clear dark central band).

output_contract.notes: The core FDTD simulation is the main computational reproduction; structural audits of derived properties from the two CSV artifacts verify the LSPR and field enhancement patterns quantitatively. No absolute values from the paper are exposed.
